about: Hand-researched buyer targets for a 150-piece lot of 2011-2016 German body panels (doors, hoods, fenders) sitting in New Castle County, Delaware. Compiled from public web listings on 2026-08-23. Phone numbers and addresses come from business directories and the businesses' own sites - confirm on the call before you rely on them. 'confidence' is how much of the record was corroborated: full = address + phone, partial = address or phone, name_only = business identified but contact details not confirmed.

leads.name: German Auto Resort LLC
leads.description: Family-owned BMW and Mercedes salvage yard, two acres of computerised inventory. Buys whole cars and parts lots.
leads.notes: Named in the landlord's research as a specialist target. Best single candidate for a one-call bulk buyout of the German panels.

leads.name: LKQ Potomac German Auto Parts
leads.description: LKQ's dedicated German-make recycled-parts operation. Recycled OE and reconditioned replacement parts for BMW, Mercedes, Audi, VW. Mon-Fri 8-5.
leads.notes: Corporate buyer - they buy bulk batches to refresh inventory but price to a matrix. Get a written offer; use it as the floor for everyone else.

leads.name: Euro Parts
leads.description: Independent used German/European parts specialist.
leads.notes: Named in the landlord's research. Independent, so faster to a yes than LKQ, and they have an email - send the inventory sheet.

leads.name: HM Auto Parts & Recycling
leads.description: OEM used auto parts and end-of-life vehicle dismantling. Explicitly serves southern PA, northern DE (Bear, Newark, New Castle) and northern MD. Stocks doors and mirrors.
leads.notes: Closest full dismantler that already sells into New Castle County - about 30 miles. Get the phone number off the site and call the buyer, not the counter.

leads.name: Shuster's Auto Salvage
leads.description: 40+ years in business. Used domestic and foreign parts, scrap vehicle purchasing, towing.
leads.notes: Ten minutes from the lot. Even if they only take part of it, they can move panels the same day with their own truck.

leads.name: Delaware Auto Salvage
leads.description: Large used-parts inventory covering domestic and foreign models.
leads.notes: In the same town as the lot. Zero transport cost makes their lowball offer competitive with a distant buyer's better price.

leads.name: B&F Towing Co. - Used Auto Parts
leads.description: Used parts yard serving New Castle, Wilmington and Newark. Runs its own towing fleet.
leads.notes: Owns the trucks, which removes the biggest objection to buying 150 panels.

leads.name: Casper's Auto Parts
leads.description: Used auto parts yard, organised inventory, broad selection.

leads.name: Two Guys Auto Parts
leads.description: Used auto parts yard in Wilmington.

leads.name: LKQ Pick Your Part - Edgewood
leads.description: Self-service LKQ yard stocking domestic, import, truck and SUV vehicles.
leads.notes: Self-service yards buy cars, not loose panels - low priority for this lot. Kept as a scrap-floor comparison.

leads.name: IAA New Castle (Insurance Auto Auctions)
leads.description: Insurance salvage auction branch, IAA location 620.
leads.notes: Do not sell to them - their registered buyers are the rebuilders who need these panels. Ask the branch manager to point you at the local heavy buyers.

leads.name: Copart Delaware
leads.description: Copart salvage auction yard serving Delaware.
leads.notes: Same play as IAA: a referral source into the rebuilder network, not a buyer.

leads.name: German Auto Werks
leads.description: Independent service and repair for Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Mini and Volkswagen.
leads.notes: In New Castle itself. Even if they only buy a handful of panels, they know every German-car body shop in the county.

leads.name: Euro-Tech
leads.description: Full service for Mercedes, BMW and other European makes.
leads.notes: Named in the landlord's research as a Wilmington euro specialist.

leads.name: Performance Auto Specialists
leads.description: European repair since 1991 - BMW, Mercedes, Volvo, VW, Mini, Jaguar, Audi, Porsche.
leads.notes: Named in the landlord's research (as European Performance).

leads.name: Eurocar
leads.description: European automotive specialty shop, 35+ years in Wilmington.

leads.name: Pinter Autohaz
leads.description: Independent Audi and Volkswagen specialist, 20+ years.
leads.notes: Audi/VW only - pitch the Audi fenders and hoods specifically.

leads.name: Ewing Auto Repair
leads.description: European and import vehicle repair in Newark.

leads.name: B & G Auto Body
leads.description: Family-owned independent collision and paint shop serving New Castle County for over a decade; works with a network of shops.
leads.notes: Says it runs a network of trusted shops - one call could reach several buyers.

leads.name: Hertrich Collision Center of Bear
leads.description: Family-owned collision centre repairing all makes and models.
leads.notes: High volume - worth asking whether their estimators write used OEM panels.

leads.name: Newark AutoWorld Collision Center
leads.description: Collision repair, 30+ years, behind Newark ToyotaWorld.

leads.name: Delaware Estate Sales and Auctions
leads.description: Estate auctions, sales, appraisals and liquidations based in Wilmington.
leads.notes: Local liquidator - the hands-off exit if you would rather not run outreach. Expect 10-20% seller commission.

leads.name: AJ Willner Auctions
leads.description: Nearly 100 years liquidating industrial, commercial and business assets; runs its own online auction platform for business liquidations and insolvency.
leads.notes: Regional heavyweight. Worth a call for a commission quote to benchmark the local option against.

leads.name: Specialized German
leads.description: West Coast's largest used Porsche/BMW dismantler, 7-acre facility, buys European cars in all conditions, ships nationwide.
leads.notes: Cross-country freight kills the margin on 150 panels. Kept only as a price reference - ask what they pay per panel and compare.
